This sorghum plot is small, only a little piece of land, and sorghum is not like maize — it grows even when the rains are not so good, so I do not waste my fertilizer on it. I keep the fertilizer from the coupon, if I get one, for my maize plots. On this piece I put the kraal sweepings and some ash from the kitchen, and I use the seed I saved from last year from my mother's sorghum. I weed myself with my daughter, and the birds I chase away when the heads start to fill.
